scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; 11 attributable financing, grant, debt and ownership events for 8 companies approved pending rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: Nuburu SEC filing reports completion and USD2m contractual consideration for Lyocon

rounds.note_en: Nuburu acquired all Lyocon ownership interests for USD750,000 cash and two USD625,000 convertible notes. A contingent earnout of up to USD1m and accounting fair-value adjustments are excluded from the closed contractual consideration.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Nuburu's completed 2026 acquisition is recorded at USD2m contractual consideration, excluding contingent earnout and accounting fair-value adjustments.

sources.title: BAE Systems results report acquisition of Malloy Aeronautics for GBP60m cash

rounds.note_en: BAE Systems acquired 100% of Malloy Aeronautics for GBP60m cash. Working-capital adjustments and contingent consideration were not quantified and are excluded; the amount is secondary acquisition consideration rather than issuer proceeds.
rounds.coverage_note_en: BAE Systems' completed 2024 acquisition is recorded at GBP60m cash consideration, excluding unquantified adjustments and contingent consideration.

sources.title: Cohort final results report GBP8.847m total consideration for the 2014 MCL majority acquisition

rounds.note_en: Cohort's final results report GBP8.847m total consideration for its initial 50% plus one share acquisition. The amount is secondary acquisition consideration, not issuer growth proceeds.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Cohort's 2014 majority acquisition and 2017 purchase of the remaining stake are recorded separately as secondary ownership transactions.

sources.title: Cohort confirms GBP5.1m cash purchase of the remaining 49.999% of MCL

rounds.note_en: Cohort paid approximately GBP5.1m cash for the remaining 49.999% stake. Later surplus-cash and earnout settlement is excluded from this recorded closing consideration.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Cohort's 2014 majority acquisition and 2017 purchase of the remaining stake are recorded separately as secondary ownership transactions.

rounds.stage: Acquisition by Flowing River Capital Partners

sources.title: Marshall confirms Flowing River Capital Partners' acquisition of Marshall Land Systems

rounds.note_en: Marshall confirms the completed acquisition but does not disclose consideration. No amount is inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2025 Flowing River acquisition and 2026 Eden Rock debt raise are recorded at publicly disclosed terms without inventing undisclosed amounts.

sources.title: Kroll confirms a debt raise for Marshall Land Systems led by Eden Rock Credit

rounds.note_en: Kroll confirms closing of the debt raise and names Eden Rock Credit as lead lender. The facility amount is undisclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2025 Flowing River acquisition and 2026 Eden Rock debt raise are recorded at publicly disclosed terms without inventing undisclosed amounts.

sources.title: Electro Optic Systems confirms completion of the MARSS acquisition
Electro Optic Systems announces USD36m upfront consideration for MARSS

rounds.note_en: EOS completed the acquisition with USD36m upfront cash consideration. The contingent earnout, initially stated as up to EUR100m and later amended, is excluded from the closed amount.
rounds.coverage_note_en: EOS's completed 2026 acquisition is recorded at USD36m upfront cash consideration, excluding contingent earnout.

sources.title: Freedom Fund profile reports a USD300k MaXon Systems pre-seed led by Freedom Fund

rounds.note_en: The investor profile reports a USD300,000 pre-seed led by Freedom Fund with Defender Ventures and an unnamed angel. The unnamed investor is omitted; a conflicting secondary report of USD350,000 remains flagged for reconciliation.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2025 pre-seed is recorded at the investor-reported USD300k and the 2026 funding announcement at undisclosed amount; a conflicting USD350k secondary figure remains unresolved.

sources.title: Tech.eu reports MaXon Systems funding from Green Flag Ventures, BRAVE1, Freedom Fund VC and Big Defence

rounds.note_en: The report identifies four participating backers but does not disclose the round amount or individual contributions. No role beyond participation is inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2025 pre-seed is recorded at the investor-reported USD300k and the 2026 funding announcement at undisclosed amount; a conflicting USD350k secondary figure remains unresolved.

sources.title: Bpifrance confirms the more-than-EUR50m MC2 Technologies transaction
Andera confirms MC2 Technologies acquisition financing and Tikehau unitranche debt

rounds.note_en: The transaction exceeded EUR50m and combined Andera and Bpifrance equity with Tikehau unitranche debt. It is recorded as mixed transaction financing and does not imply that the full amount was primary growth capital for MC2 Technologies.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The completed 2021 more-than-EUR50m acquisition financing is recorded as mixed equity and unitranche debt.

sources.title: MESKO reports PLN400m Reprivatisation Fund financing for Project 400

rounds.note_en: MESKO reports PLN466.7m total Project 400 investment, comprising PLN400m from the Reprivatisation Fund and PLN66.7m of company funds. Only the external public contribution is recorded.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The official PLN400m Reprivatisation Fund contribution to Project 400 is recorded separately from MESKO's own PLN66.7m investment.
